calibration_finite_vs_poisson.note: Finite model uses train empirical announce-time fractions * mean dynamic count. Poisson uses homogeneous rate over the full horizon (old misspecification).

decision.label: greedy_nominal_remains_strongest_empirical_contribution
decision.reason: Final held-out BAP did not beat greedy-nominal (delta~-2.167, tally={'better': 1, 'worse': 2, 'tie': 3}). Recommend nominal CC-E as strongest empirical result; predictive superiority not shown.
